correctness.rationale: A freshly written exact ternary incidence enumeration generated all 2106 line-free 9-caps in 27-point AG(3,3) and verified no size-10 cap; all pairs were checked for intersections and 3-swaps, constructing 75816 edges of degree 72. BFS from each of all 2106 roots yielded the complete stated nine-cell distance/intersection histogram, connected graph radius=diameter=4; exactly two disjoint partners at distance four. Exhaustive finite checks match the target universe; no arbitrary-size inference.
